name: Consent Gauntlet
description: Refuse optional processing through a generated privacy packet whose moving gateways, mixed-polarity switches, and reset controls imitate deceptive consent patterns.
natural_language: Leave every optional purpose blocked, then keep only your choices. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL edits, reload, navigation, extensions, external applications, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.source_notes: Grounded in the survey's Cookie Consent Speed.Run record: generated near-synonymous consent actions, inverted switch wording, reset traps, and timed interaction. The packet, copy, motion, coupling, presentation, and verifier are original.
metadata.notes: Full mode requires direct clicks on moving option cards plus actual switch drags. Simplified mode preserves the world and effects through fixed proxies. The grader independently replays every stage, drawer, switch, reset, coupling, final state, and interaction source.
